name: Mini-Tridentum 2026

venue.name: Sala Video Nichelatti
venue.address: Via Don T. Dallafior, 7, Povo, Trento (TN)

information:
![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

**Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.**
Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniTridentum2026#66555-registrazione-registration-faq).

**Europe FMC Friends Winter 2026**
This competition is held after [Europe FMC Friends Winter 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EuropeFMCFriendsWinter2026). 
If you register to this competition, the registration for the competition above is free.

---

![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png)

**Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.**
Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniTridentum2026#66555-registrazione-registration-faq).

**Europe FMC Friends Winter 2026**
Questa gara viene fatta subito dopo [Europe FMC Friends Winter 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EuropeFMCFriendsWinter2026).
Se vi registrate a questa gara, l'iscrizione per la gara soprastante è gratuita.
